settings.editor: From upfront eligibility verification to clean claim submission, certified coding, aggressive appeals, and aged A/R recovery — we manage the complete payer revenue cycle.
Every single claim passes our rigorous six-tier quality control protocol before ever reaching a commercial or government clearinghouse.
Patient identity, subscriber policy details, active coverage status, and primary/secondary coordination verified.

Dynamic clearinghouse validation across 3,000,000+ real-time payer edits before electronic claim transmission.

Guaranteed electronic 837 claim file dispatch within 24–48 hours, fully audited against carrier timely filing deadlines.
Eliminating claim errors before care is delivered through strict upfront payer verification.
Verify patient active coverage, primary/secondary policy status, co-pays, deductibles, and pre-existing condition rules prior to scheduled visits to prevent claim rejections.
